tweets.author: Bob Nightengale
tweets.html: The Boston Red Sox's sweep over the Chicago White Sox marked their sixth sweep over a team who entered the series in first place.It's the first time time a team has swept six first-place teams in a single season since the Expansion era in 1961, per  @EliasSports.

tweets.author: Jeff Passan
tweets.html: San Francisco Giants announcer Mike Krukow will retire after this season, ending a 36-year career in which he and he best friend and former teammate, Duane Kuiper, formed one of the best broadcasting duos in baseball. For generations of Giants fans, Kruk is their voice of summer.

tweets.html: That's it for Casey Mize, who's yanked after just 3 1/3 innings in his Padres' debut after 11-day layoff.He gives up 9 hits (including 5 in a row) and 5 runs with 3 walks and a strikeout, departing with two runners on base.He induced just 2 swings and misses in his 77 pitches.
